video_title: 当电影感配色遇上中国古诗词

rendering_pipeline.render_path: path-traced CGI composite + film emulation grade
rendering_pipeline.tone_mapping: ACES filmic tone mapping with lifted blacks and rolled-off highlights

lift.description: slightly lifted cool gray shadows, crushed in B&W source frames, opened in graded frames

gamma.description: warm mid-tone bias in golden scene, cool green bias in lotus scene

gain.description: golden highlight rolloff in cloud-sea scene

key_light.type: diffuse skylight + low-angle sun (golden scene); overcast hemispheric (lotus scene); cool moon key (pavilion scene)

light_shadow.ambient_type: volumetric sky dome, heavy mist bounce

god_rays.technique: none visible — light is fully diffused by mist

fog.type: height-exponential aerial perspective, dense low-lying cloud sea
fog.aerial_perspective: strong — distant peaks fade into cloud deck, atmospheric haze increases with depth; graded scenes tint fog warm gold (#d4a04a) or jade green (#b8d4c8)

ao.type: screen-space ambient occlusion + baked contact AO on rocks and pavilion

material.name: weathered granite rock steps and cliff

water.wave_technique: gerstner waves, very low amplitude, near-still lake

particles.name: drifting mist/spray particles above lotus pond

motion.type: slow dolly-in / locked-off with gentle parallax

composition.type: rule-of-thirds with framed negative space; solitary figure placed on right/left third, vast misty void occupies 60-70% of frame
composition.horizon_position: upper third in mountain scenes (cloud sea fills lower 2/3), middle in lotus scene, lower third in moon pavilion
composition.symmetry_axis: asymmetric — figure offset, natural frame elements (pine branch top-left, willow branches top, pavilion eaves top-right) balance the composition

qiyun_shengdong.evidence: Frame 2: robed scholar's hem catches wind and trails gold against the cloud sea, the entire scene breathes through volumetric mist; Frame 4: willow branches and lotus pond exhale cool green air — spirit resonance is the dominant quality.

gufa_yongbi.evidence: Frame 1: pine branch silhouette at top edge and jagged peak ridgelines read like forceful ink outlines (like Ma Yuan's one-corner composition); Frame 6: pavilion dougong brackets and eave line have strong structural bone — though as CGI the brushwork feel is inherited, not literal.

yingwu_xiangxing.evidence: Frame 3-4: lotus leaves, willow fronds, distant single boat are rendered with recognizable natural form; Frame 1-2: granite steps and karst peaks have credible sculptural volume — form follows observed nature rather than pure abstraction.

suilei_fucai.evidence: This is the video's explicit thesis: Frame 1 (B&W) → Frame 2 (graded to amber-gold cloud sea); Frame 3 (B&W) → Frame 4/5 (graded to jade-green lotus with pink blossoms); Frame 6 carries swatches of indigo (#1a2a6b), cinnabar (#6b1a1a) and rice-white (#e8e8e8) for the moon scene — color is applied by poetic category per scene.

jingying_weizhi.evidence: Frame 1-2: scholar on right third, pine branch frames top-left, peaks emerge from cloud sea at golden ratio intersections; Frame 3-4: figure on left third, lotus mass anchors bottom-right, willow arcs from top; Frame 6: moon placed upper-left, pavilion eaves upper-right, figure on right third — balanced void-filled planning.

chuanyi_moxie.evidence: The whole video is a pastiche of canonical Chinese poetic imagery: Huangshan cloud-sea (Frame 1-2), Jiangnan lotus-pond parting (Frame 3-5, echoing 采莲曲), moon-over-water longing (Frame 6, echoing 望月怀远/静夜思) — it consciously transmits classical painting and poetic motifs into cinematic language.

effect_to_library_mapping.library: Unreal Engine / Houdini volumetric volume rendering

motion.camera_motion_type: slow locked-off wide shot with gentle dolly-in, cut between three scenes
motion.transition_type: hard cut between B&W source and graded reveal; subtle cross-dissolve between frame 4 and 5 (lotus loop)
